info.title: API.SH: Agoda
info.description: The Agoda API from API.SH: public Agoda data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What Agoda suggests for a hotel search: cities, areas, landmarks, airports and hotels, each with type, id (a city id or hotel id ready for /agoda/v1/hotels and /agoda/v1/hotel), name, city, country, address, number of properties, popular flag and search link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/agoda-destinations

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A city, area, landmark, airport or hotel name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An Agoda property: name, stars, full address, area, coordinates, review score with category grades, description, amenities by group, useful info (check-in times, distances), policies, places of interest, nearby essentials and photos. Give `id` or an Agoda hotel page `url`. Also `room_types`: each room type with size and view features, beds, occupancy, amenities, images, cheapest nightly price and its offers for the stay (nightly price with and without taxes, total, cancellation terms, breakfast, benefits, rooms left).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/agoda-hotel

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agoda hotel id (the `id` field of /agoda/v1/hotels).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Agoda hotel page URL, e.g. https://www.agoda.com/hotel-du-collectionneur-arc-de-triomphe/hotel/paris-fr.html (used when id is absent).

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days from today).

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 2 nights after check_in).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults (default 2).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Rooms (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hotels in a city on Agoda for a stay: name, stars, review score and count, area, coordinates, nightly and total price (with and without taxes), cancellation and payment terms, amenities, landmarks and photos. 45 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Give `city` (Agoda city id) or `q` (a place name). Filter with `min_price`, `max_price`, `stars`, `min_rating`, `property_type` and `facilities` (`applied_filters` echoes them); each property also has `accommodation_type_id`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/agoda-hotels

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Agoda city id (the `city=` number in an Agoda search URL). Either city or q is required.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place name, resolved to an Agoda city (used when city is absent).

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days from today).

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 2 nights after check_in).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults (default 2).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Rooms (default 1).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Child ages, comma separated (e.g. 5,8).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default ranking).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Price currency (default USD).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest nightly price before taxes, in `currency`.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest nightly price before taxes, in `currency`. The price filter is applied page by page, so pages can hold fewer than 45 properties and `total_results` counts properties before it.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: Star ratings to keep, comma-separated, e.g. `4,5`.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Lowest guest review score, 1-10, e.g. `8`.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Accommodation type ids to keep, comma-separated (the `accommodation_type_id` of results, e.g. `34` hotels).

parameters.name: facilities
parameters.description: Facility ids, comma-separated (from the `facility_ids` of results): properties with any of them.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Guest reviews of an Agoda property: rating, title, text, pros and cons, date, stay month, reviewer (name, country, traveler type, room, nights) and the property response. Up to about 40 a page (the selected source plus partner sources). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; the list ends at the first page with no reviews (`next_page` null). `providers` lists the review sources (Agoda 332 is the default).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/agoda-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agoda hotel id. Either id or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Agoda hotel page URL (used when id is absent).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default helpful).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Review source id from `providers` (default 332, Agoda).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews mentioning this text.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
